purpose: The queue of live decisions this project supports. Each entry names the decision, its default if nothing changes, the evidence required, the current blocker, and a stopping rule fixed in advance.
standing_constraints: No wager is placed and no price is published as advice.
No numerical NFL claim exists unless an official or reference source is linked on the same row.
A blank cell is an unanswered question, never a zero and never an estimate.
Nothing becomes eligible by being written down; eligibility requires all declared gates.

decisions.decision: Adopt an explicit decision brief as the project's front door
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: The site keeps publishing research state without stating what decision it supports.
decisions.evidence_required: A named decision per row, a default, and a stopping rule.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if any row lacks a default or a stopping rule after review.

decisions.decision: Order improvement work by decision impact and evidence readiness
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Work proceeds in the order ideas arrive.
decisions.evidence_required: Four predeclared scores per suggestion.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if a chosen item scores below a rejected one without a recorded reason.

decisions.decision: Price a joint bet only when a correlation interval clears a predeclared deadband
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Parlay tools would multiply marginals and silently assume independence.
decisions.evidence_required: Paired leg outcomes, a correlation interval, and a deadband fixed before the test.
decisions.current_blocker: No aligned leg-level dataset, so every joint price is blank.
decisions.stopping_rule: Abandon the rule if a priced joint ever falls outside the Frechet bounds of its marginals.

decisions.decision: Report changed starters from official Game Books and leave depth tiers blank
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Availability analysis would rest on injury designations that were shown to contradict participation.
decisions.evidence_required: Two official Game Books sharing a club, plus the matching injury report.
decisions.current_blocker: Only one club-game pair has been verified; no season archive.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if the NFL begins publishing depth charts or string designations.

decisions.decision: Keep both official availability counterexamples on the site permanently
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Readers re-learn the same two errors every season.
decisions.evidence_required: The named players, their published status and their published participation.
decisions.stopping_rule: Retire a case only if the NFL corrects the underlying record.

decisions.decision: Maintain a single question, information and answer register with three states
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Unknowns stay scattered and unowned.
decisions.evidence_required: Each answered question carries a linked source; each open question names the blocking artefact.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if a row is marked answered without a link.

decisions.decision: Prefer Game Books over live designation feeds when the two conflict
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: A designation feed is treated as a participation record, which it is not.
decisions.evidence_required: A Game Book showing who actually started and who was inactive.
decisions.current_blocker: Archive coverage is one pair of games.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if a Game Book is shown to disagree with the official participation record.

decisions.decision: Keep the no-live-wager policy and require an operator source before any settlement claim
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Research algebra can be mistaken for a recommendation, and jurisdiction goes unasked.
decisions.evidence_required: A regulator page and an operator market-rules page in the source register.
decisions.current_blocker: The regulator page establishes a framework, not any individual's eligibility.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if any row asserts a settlement rule without an operator citation.

decisions.decision: Rank the competition on a simultaneous lower bound within matched tracks only
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Raw return would reward variance and multiplicity.
decisions.evidence_required: Forecasts, quotes, intervals, and all gates passed.
decisions.current_blocker: No forecasts, quotes or evaluated gates exist, so the leaderboard is empty.
decisions.stopping_rule: Abandon the ranking if a ranked entry later fails a gate.

decisions.decision: Do not seal a final test season until a power study declares the required sample
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: The one untouched season gets spent on a test that cannot answer the question.
decisions.evidence_required: Minimum detectable effect and required sample per candidate family.
decisions.current_blocker: No power study has been run.
decisions.stopping_rule: Irreversible by design: once a season is opened it cannot be resealed.

decisions.decision: Acquire a season-long official Game Book archive before fitting any efficiency model
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Every modelling claim stays unfalsifiable.
decisions.evidence_required: Complete Game Books for the training and sealed windows, keyed by stable game ID, with redistribution terms.
decisions.current_blocker: No archive, and redistribution rights are unresolved.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if a smaller verified dataset is demonstrated to be sufficient for the declared effect.

decisions.decision: Never back-fill a missing closing line
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Price columns would be filled with reconstructions that look authoritative.
decisions.evidence_required: A licensed historical quote source, or a forward capture with timestamps.
decisions.current_blocker: No licensed quote history exists in this project.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen only when quotes can be cited per market and per timestamp.

decisions.decision: Group the site navigation by intent: Decision, Evidence, Research, Review
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Decision content sits level with background material and gets lost.
decisions.evidence_required: Every page reachable, current page marked, mobile layout intact.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if any page becomes unreachable or the current-page marker breaks.

decisions.decision: Model same-game dependence through one shared scenario vector rather than a correlation matrix
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Three-leg joints would be priced with an unidentified pairwise approximation.
decisions.evidence_required: A simulated joint calibrated on held-out joint events.
decisions.current_blocker: Depends on the archive and on a validated scenario model.
decisions.stopping_rule: Abandon if held-out joint calibration is worse than direct joint estimation.

decisions.decision: Treat offensive-line combination continuity as a feature to ablation-test, not a finding
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: A plausible but untested mechanism is either ignored or over-claimed.
decisions.evidence_required: Consecutive-start counts per five-man combination and an ablation on later weeks.
decisions.stopping_rule: Abandon if ablation shows no change in predictive quality.

decisions.decision: Refuse any suggestion that cannot name what would falsify it
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Unfalsifiable ideas persist and crowd out testable work.
decisions.evidence_required: A falsification field on every suggestion, enforced by the validator.
decisions.stopping_rule: Reopen if an accepted item is shown to have no possible disconfirming observation.

decisions.decision: Whether to acquire a licensed market-price archive (S-17).
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Market-line and difference columns stay blank and ROI/CLV remain uncomputable.
decisions.evidence_required: A named archive with timestamps, market definitions, settlement rules and documented reuse terms.
decisions.stopping_rule: Decide when a candidate archive with terms is in hand; abandon if no permissioned source exists after the documented search.

decisions.decision: Whether to operate the scheduled close-capture workflow every week (S-18).
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Week 10 closes are never captured; the open snapshots age ungraded.
decisions.evidence_required: At least one full week of pre-kickoff closes recorded solely by the workflow.
decisions.stopping_rule: Disable the workflow if any close is recorded after kickoff or fails its input-hash guard twice.

decisions.decision: Whether to freeze a backtest design for the signal score (S-19).
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: The leaderboard signal column stays blank; elo-v1 stays a labelled unvalidated artefact.
decisions.evidence_required: A frozen design document (markets, grading, folds, thresholds, correction) dated before evaluation.
decisions.stopping_rule: Evaluate once under the frozen design; no re-runs after seeing results without a new frozen design.

decisions.decision: Whether to adopt the signal/staking split as competition law (S-20).
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: Any future leaderboard defaults to the split design already published on its page.
decisions.evidence_required: A competition-rules row in the decision brief marking the split as adopted or rejected.
decisions.stopping_rule: Decide before any strategy becomes eligible; reopening later is allowed only between seasons.

decisions.decision: Whether to require game-centre row verification before ROI use (S-21).
decisions.default_if_nothing_changes: The feed stays at structurally consistent, and no ROI claim is made from it.
decisions.evidence_required: Per-row verification states recorded in the results evidence file with retrieval dates.
decisions.stopping_rule: If a game-centre disagrees with a stored row, halt ROI use until the row is corrected and re-verified.
